meta.name: pr-to-video
meta.description: Turn a GitHub pull request (a PR URL, owner/repo#N, or 'this PR' in a checked-out repo) into a code-change explainer video — changelog, feature reveal, fix, or refactor walkthrough built from the diff, commits, and files: the input is a code change, not a website. Not a product promo (/product-launch-video) or a no-PR topic explainer (/faceless-explainer). Unclear → /hyperframes.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 把一次代码改动做成一集讲解视频,讲清改了什么
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果每次发版都要向非技术的同事解释改了什么
copy.tagline_en: Turn a code change into a short explainer video of what changed
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you must explain code changes to non-technical teammates

howto.what: 它把 GitHub PR 读进来,基于 diff、提交和文件逐帧做出代码变更讲解视频:changelog、功能发布、修复或重构走查。项目建在外部目录,产出 renders/video.mp4。
howto.when: 当你在已检出的仓库里给出 PR 链接、owner/repo#N,或直接说「这个 PR」时触发,输入必须是代码改动。意图不清或不涉及 PR 时会先转到 /hyperframes。

say.text: 把 owner/repo#1842 这个 PR 做成讲解视频
say.note: 会拉取该 PR 的 diff 和提交,再规划分镜

say.text: 给这个 PR 做视频,时长控制在 90 秒左右
say.note: 长度按 PR 规模给出建议后确认

say.text: 做成 changelog 风格,开场先讲清改了什么
say.note: 按 PR 原型(修复、重构等)进入脚本评审

howto.what_en: Point it at a GitHub PR and it reads the diff, commits, and files, then builds a code-change explainer video frame by frame — changelog, feature reveal, fix, or refactor walkthrough — rendered to renders/video.mp4.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you give a PR URL, an owner/repo#N ref, or say "this PR" in a checked-out repo; the input must be a code change. Unclear intent or a non-PR request is routed to /hyperframes first.

say_en.text: Turn this PR into a video: owner/repo#1842
say_en.note: Fetches the PR diff and commits, then plans the storyboard.

say_en.text: Make a video for owner/repo#1842, around 90 seconds
say_en.note: Length is set from the PR size per the brief.

say_en.text: Do a changelog-style video for this PR, open with what changed
say_en.note: Picks the PR archetype and drafts storyboard and script.
